findings: write_config aggressive then balanced retains read_max_lines300 and grep_max_results100 because zero-valued profile limits are omitted from owned pairs. Fresh balanced serialization omits both keys. This demonstrates history-dependent configuration text, not downstream unlimited behavior: runtime defaults were not reinterpreted in this control.

Public select_profile accepts an inconsistent zero-scenario/high-average analysis and selects aggressive because0==0. High average60 with zero quality passes of10 selects balanced; only aggressive selection requires all-pass. Synthetic analysis controls, not observed normal quick_analysis outputs.
quick_analysis uses one synthetic git-status sample and line-count reduction, with a single modified/Changes substring quality check. It does not execute a multi-repository quality benchmark.

budget_params creates Read/Grep JSON limit patches but receives no existing caller limit. Actual patch merging and enforcement require separately reviewed callers; no claim that this function alone preserves stricter requested limits.

write_config ignores backup-copy errors and treats read_to_string errors as empty before overwriting. These remain source observations; current owned valid-text control preserves user persona and exact previous bytes in backup.
transfer_decision: Configuration transitions need explicit reset semantics and validation before calibration. Do not treat one synthetic quality signal as duplicate recall qualification. No foreign production code copied.
